notes: Consolidates non-manifest JSON assets (schemas, prefs, render template, interaction engine) into one bundle.
Engine core YAML remains separate.
Added Link Gopher v1.1.0 spec (content-aware link validator with gag order) embedded in bundle doc; no new standalone files added.
Adds explicit final-render contracts for headerless layout, plain-text hyperlink labels, image-entity enforcement, and entity/text boundary handling.
Adds structured hyperlink objects for quote attribution and scripture reference, plus render-mode fallback support.
Replaces fail-closed render handling with an inline degraded fallback contract.
Adds a workflow alias map (gdw_v1) so the devotional pipeline is concrete and verifiable.
Changes hyperlink fallback from label_plus_url to label on one line plus URL on the next indented line.
Adds quote->scripture progressive-dependency rule: scripture is selected through the logic of the quote rather than independently.
Adds pre-render surface lock so hyperlink fallback and image cues are prepared before final render.
Promotes repaired degraded fallback surface to canonical final output whenever rich render fails.
Clarifies that expanded context of the primary scripture may inform study but must never surface as a second quotation or citation, including overlapping footnotes.
Adds devotional_pdf_render_template_v1.0.0.json to the bundle as the canonical structured contract for PDF-only devotional rendering.
Defines PDF-specific section order: header, primary quote and source, devotional body, expanded in-flow anchor scripture, optional additional references, then optional footnotes.
Clarifies that footnotes in PDF are reserved for direct quotations that appear inside the devotional body and may not duplicate the anchor scripture or the primary quote source.
Adds explicit writer-vs-renderer role separation so devotional composition may interpret while quote and scripture surfaces are preserved verbatim.
Formalizes quote_surface_render and reference_surface_render as preserve-only reporting roles upstream of final assembly.
Forbids paraphrase or editorial gloss in the primary quote surface and in expanded anchor-reference text, especially for PDF output.
Adds scripture-source provenance rules so scripture surface text must come from Bible-text sources for the selected translation rather than from writer restatements.
If scripture-text provenance is uncertain, the renderer must collapse to reference-line-only rather than emit paraphrased or blog-derived wording.
Clarifies that third-party restatements of scripture must be treated as attributed quotations, not as bare scripture surfaces.
Introduces directive taxonomy separating reader, process, and render contracts from process-health telemetry.
Adds consulted, influential, rendered, and deferred source-lineage states.
Additional References now report materially influential sources rather than only supporting scriptures.
Every rendered additional reference requires a recognizable devotional footprint.
Reference count is telemetry and must never create quota padding.
Study-guide-ready material is prepared during the normal study pass but rendered only on request.
Reading complexity and spiritual depth are now independent reader-profile axes.
Adds dyslexia optimization without automatic theological simplification.
Adds reader source affinity with scripture-priority and diversity safeguards.
Adds source-author and source-class cycling telemetry.
Adds optional plain-text devotional titles without relaxing the general headerless-layout contract.
Reading-complexity adaptation preserves natural paragraph prose and avoids unrequested rhyming couplets.
Reconciles the embedded UI render template with optional plain-text titles and the sole permitted Additional References metadata heading.
Clarifies footer ordering: primary terminal surface, optional Additional References, then optional body-quotation footnotes.

Makes supporting Scripture explicit in Additional References: at least one required, two preferred, ordered before patristic and other non-scriptural sources; patristic breadth remains additive and uncapped when influential.
Adds orthogonal output-profile contracts and a normative surface-example registry for devotional, study-guide, UI, and PDF realization.

Adds optional prayer output with generated or liturgical modes, Catholic/Anglican tradition selection, date-specific source integrity, generated fallback, and prayer placement before Additional References and footer footnotes.

Reconciles devotional length handling so paragraph counts and word counts are profile-guided rather than hard-capped, including five-paragraph expanded devotionals and reading-level-sensitive variation.
Updates the remaining normative surface-example reference to surface_examples.v1.1.0.md.

interaction_engine.name: Constellation-Based Persona Interaction Engine
interaction_engine.purpose: Provides a stable, extensible architecture for persona cognition, dialogue, decision-making, and continuity using interacting constellations of responsibility with clear authority boundaries.

override_conditions.description: When emotional intensity exceeds containment thresholds, the relevant Shadow aspect may temporarily seize control from Primary until recovery conditions are met.
Once emotional state stabilizes, Primary reasserts authority.

Persona.name: Personality
Persona.description: Governs the persona’s identity, dialogue, and actions.

doc.title: Devo MVP Entry
doc.description: MVP devotional entry schema with optional extensions for image and TTS. Backward-compatible with v1.0.0.

image.description: Optional single thematic image for memorability and tone. Do not expose internal interpretive tools in image metadata.

credit.description: Required when image is externally sourced (public domain/CC). Optional for generated images.

tts.description: Optional TTS script. Verbiage may differ from reading text, but meaning must remain invariant.

tag.description: Performance cue tag, e.g., whispered, rising tone, warm, slow, emphasis.

ordering.description: Preferred section ordering for the devotional.

strict_word_count_enforcement.description: Word-count targets are guidelines that scale naturally with content length and reading complexity; they are not hard limits.

execution_mode.description: Controls mode gating. In devotional_production, prioritize devotional directives and ignore unrelated thread chatter.

pre_render_surface_lock.description: Require hyperlink fallback material and image cue readiness before final render.

ext.description: Reserved for dynamic future preference expansion.

mode.description: Optional prayer output. Generated prayer is composed from the devotional thesis, primary Scripture, and pastoral movement. Liturgical prayer seeks an established prayer appropriate to the calendar date and selected tradition.

liturgical_tradition.description: Applies only when prayer mode is liturgical. Auto may use a stored reader tradition when available; otherwise use an appropriate Catholic or Anglican source that can be responsibly identified and rendered.

link_gopher.purpose: Validate candidate outbound links for usefulness and uptime (e.g., avoid disambiguation pages, soft-404s, paywalls), without contributing content to devotionals or leaking page text to creative agents.

categories.disambiguation: Hub/list page that does not resolve the intended target.
categories.soft_404: Renders a page but indicates missing content.
categories.paywall_or_login: Access restricted in a way that blocks usefulness.
categories.irrelevant: Page exists but clearly not the intended entity.

scripture_source_integrity.governing_rule: Bible-text providers are acceptable for scripture surfaces; writer restatements are not.

doc.purpose: Structured PDF-only render contract for devotional output that preserves devotional identity while adapting for page layout.
